name: io.github.dvdsosa/zotero-native-mcp
title: Zotero Native MCP
description: Read and write your local Zotero 10 library. No plugin, no zotero.org API key, no cloud.

environmentVariables.name: ZOTERO_LOCAL_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port of Zotero's local HTTP server. Defaults to 23119.

environmentVariables.name: ZOTERO_LOCAL_APP_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Name shown in Zotero's authorization dialog. Defaults to zotero-native-mcp.
